name: Whispers of the Pit's fear and slow break on damage (#854)
contract: Whispers of the Pit 805235 (ground-targeted) and its trigger 807590 (self-centred, same tooltip): "Unleash fel energy upon enemies ... fearing them and slowing their movement speed by -80% for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect." On 805235, effect 0 is aura 7 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_FEAR, mechanic 5 MECHANIC_FEAR - a real fear, matching the tooltip) and effect 2 is aura 33 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED, DBC base -81 resolving to -80 because DieSides==1 adds 1 to EffectBasePoints). Both live on the same Aura instance, so removing it removes the fear and the slow together; the DBC gives no way to separate them. 805235's AuraInterruptFlags were 0x480000 (change-map/teleported bits only - bit 0x2, AURA_INTERRUPT_FLAG_TAKE_DAMAGE, was absent), so Unit::DealDamage's unconditional call to victim->RemoveAurasWithInterruptFlags(AURA_INTERRUPT_FLAG_TAKE_DAMAGE, ...) (Unit.cpp ~line 1037/1040) never matched it and no hit ever broke the fear/slow. The fix, in AscensionFelsworn::ApplyContracts (AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp), adds AURA_INTERRUPT_FLAG_TAKE_DAMAGE to 805235 and 807590. This scenario applies the fixture aura directly (set_aura), since RemoveAurasWithInterruptFlags runs inside the damage path regardless of how the aura was applied, and drives an unrelated DoT tick (Rend, 772) to reach that path without needing a live cast pipeline or a second combatant.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Apply the fear+slow to the target that will take damage
Apply the same fear+slow to a control target that will take none
Fear+slow aura is present on the damaged target
Fear+slow aura is present on the control target
Give the damaged target a plain periodic-damage tick (Rend) to reach Unit::DealDamage
Damage removed the whole aura, including the fear half
The slow half is gone too
Without damage, the same aura survives the same window
